release_notes:
- Group sync now covers park mode: when you stop, every board in the group shows the leader's park look (effect, colors, speed and brightness). Your board still parks on its own, based on its own motion.
- The headlight follows the leader's park look only if headlight sync is on for your board.
- New "Sync park mode with group" setting (on by default) in the Group Sync screen of app 1.0.3 or newer. Turn it off to keep your own park look while riding with a group. Your own park settings are kept either way.
- Fixed: a board slightly ahead of the group at slow effect speeds could jump forward in its animation instead of easing back into step.
- Every board in the group needs 1.0.4 for park sync; boards on older firmware still sync normally while riding.
